facts.text: AVERY CHEN
Product Designer · Independently authored fictional resume
m2-narrow-four-a4@example.com · https://portfolio.example/m2/m2-narrow-four-a4
PROFILE
Product designer focused on accessible public-service interfaces and documented decisions.
EXPERIENCE
Juniper Library Studio · Product Designer · 2021–2025 · Fictional employer

• Designed accessible appointment flows for the fictional Juniper Library, testing keyboard navigation and clear error recovery with staff, then documented the interaction decisions so engineering could implement consistent states across desktop and mobile screens.

• Built a reusable component inventory with engineering partners, recording focus order, contrast checks and content guidance for forms and tables, and used the inventory during weekly design reviews to keep the library scheduling interface consistent.

• Facilitated moderated research sessions for a fictional service portal, organized observations into a shared evidence log and separated reported needs from assumptions, then used prototypes to clarify confusing renewal and appointment tasks before implementation.

• Reviewed responsive prototypes with developers and support staff, checking tasks on narrow and wide viewports, documenting unresolved usability issues and comparing changes with supplied research notes.
SKILLS
Figma · Prototyping · Accessibility · Design systems · Research synthesis
EDUCATION
BA, Interaction Design · Example Institute · 2020
